name: Realistic Finnish space sci-fi, translated to English with AI

mentions.name: Realistic Finnish space sci-fi, translated to English with AI
mentions.description: A series of "realistic" space sci-fi stories written in Finnish by the author and his wife for over 20 years, now being translated into English with AI, with the quality starting to reach a publishable level. The stories skip space battles and wars in favor of a slower, more philosophical style in which light speed is the limit and interstellar travel takes centuries.
mentions.problem: There are many small languages in the world and translating from them used to be extremely expensive; AI now makes translating the Finnish stories into English viable.
mentions.source_excerpt: Me and my wife (then my girlfriend) have written "realistic" space sci-fi in Finnish for over 20 years. Now with AI we are finally able to translate our stories to English. The quality starts to be there.
